thread:
nina_sales: Customer (CapitalEdge) asks if we can do a sealed-image POC: USB delivery only, customer-controlled signing key option, and a documented hotpatch SLA. Also need pricing delta for monthly vetted patches vs quarterly. cc @oscar_se @michele_infra

oscar_se: Confirming install targets: k8s operator + a few standalone VMs. We'll provide both bundle types. Two signing flows to propose: vendor-signed (our HSM) or customer-sign (they hold root key).

michele_infra: Bundle contents we'll include:
- images/ (OCI tarballs)
- manifests/ (operator CRs or systemd units)
- checksums.sha256
- sbom.cdx.json (optionally redacted)
- bundle.sig (detached) or manifest-for-signing.json
- verify_offline.sh (no-network verifier)
Hotpatch process: customer files vulnerability ticket -> we produce minimal patch bundle (delta) with detached sig -> deliver via USB. If customer signs, we hand them the manifest to sign.

ravi_sec: Security must-haves: 1) verification tool exits non-zero on tamper, 2) recommend customer-side HSM for root key, 3) telemetry disabled by default for POC, 4) supply attestation.json showing exact digests applied.

anne_legal: Legal notes: customer-hold-key reduces our forensics; need an addendum clarifying signing responsibilities, chain-of-custody for physical transfers, and commercial impact if metering is disabled. We'll draft a one-page addendum.

oscar_se: Rough pricing guidance: monthly vetted hotpatch channel ~ +15% over base on-prem license. Emergency expedited patch SLA (4h) ~ +10% on top. Exact numbers from finance.

michele_infra: I'll stage a sample vendor-signed bundle + a sign-ready manifest set for customer-sign flow and include a short runbook by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: playbook-created: /playbooks/sealed-poc-delivery-checklist.md assigned to michele_infra, oscar_se. Due: 2026-04-07 :spiral_calendar:

nina_sales: Thanks — I'll update the customer and book a technical working session next week.
